push.title: L 0-3 vs gilbertstein | You: 6.5 (4th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your 4th worst match performance of the season, PhogsToffees: a 6.5. It stings, and stings fade.

THE GOOD
+ 92% passing on 12 attempts, up from your usual 76%. You found the open man like a dog finds the couch.
+ 1 key pass. You made your teammates look like heroes. That's real leadership.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 4. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ 3 goals conceded was worth +0.1 on its own. That's the quiet stuff that wins.

THE BAD
- Passes attempted 12, down from your usual 35. Let's turn that around by next session.
- No shots. Simple as pie: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on. We'll drill it till it's dull.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 5. That needs to look different next time out.
- Assists 0, down from your usual 1. Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.
- Their humans averaged 8.5 to our 6.5; we were second best man for man. We'll talk about it as a group, then leave it behind us.

THE UGLY
! Their best forward posted 9.7 to your 6.5. I'm gonna be straight with you: that's not good enough, and you know it.

Warm-up idea: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

Keep your chin up and your effort higher. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 0-3 vs gilbertstein | You: 6.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.5 stings. Good. It means you care. Now let's turn that sting into a plan.

THE GOOD
+ Giveaways 0, down from your usual 8. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Missed tackles 0, from 4 in your previous match. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.

THE BAD
- Passes attempted 0, down from your usual 28. Key note: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.
- No shots. Training homework: Follow every shot in. Rebounds are free goals for people who keep running.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Fix it like this: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. We don't hide from that one; we fix it.
- Their humans averaged 8.5 to our 6.5; we were second best man for man. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.

THE UGLY
! Their best forward posted 9.7 to your 6.5. That's below the line we drew together, and the line is the line.

Drill of the day: When you've got a clear look inside the box, pull the trigger. Hesitation lets defenders recover.

BellyTb1, something I want you to sleep on: Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

Rome wasn't built in a day; neither is a great player. - Coach Lasso
